description: Ministry of Power - Approve the Proposed acquisition of Land in D/S Division, Wattala
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about the acquisition of a specific parcel of land (Muthurajawelawatta) by the Ceylon Electricity Board. It details the land's location, boundaries, extent, and the claimant's information. While a government minister (Dullas Alahapperuma) is named, the core subject matter is a land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification for land and property-related matters. The mention of the minister is incidental to the primary land-related action.
